description:
Actions, angles, frequencies and explicit orbit-validity diagnostics.

Actions: (Jr,Jz,Jphi) in kpc km/s, angles radians, frequencies km/s/kpc.
Spherical quadrature is independent of AGAMA; axisymmetric Staeckel-fudge
uses the project's pinned AGAMA backend. General fields get orbit diagnostics
and unavailable invariant actions instead of invented conserved quantities.

functions.name: integrate_orbits
functions.description:
Integrate inertial Cartesian states; output shape is (epochs, particles, 6).

Initial states belong to times_myr[0]. Phi uses (km/s)^2, so its force
-grad(Phi) has (km/s)^2/kpc. Multiplying both equations by the shared
km/s-to-kpc/Myr factor gives dx/dt in kpc/Myr and dv/dt in km/s/Myr.

functions.name: recover_frequencies
functions.description:
Windowed Fourier peak refined by complex-amplitude maximization.

Cartesian fundamentals can be harmonics or combinations of action
frequencies. They are reported as spectral peaks, never auto-identified as
canonical frequencies. Frequency drift floor includes finite duration.

functions.name: finite_time_lyapunov
functions.description:
Measure finite-time tangent growth along one initial displacement.

The variational equations are d(delta x)/dt=c*delta v and
d(delta v)/dt=-c*H(Phi)*delta x, with c converting km/s to kpc/Myr.
The reported norm uses the declared length and speed scales. A single
displacement along x is an indicator, not the maximal Lyapunov exponent.

description:
Saved-snapshot scientific measurements, catalogue statistics and publication.

Readers validate complete snapshot sets and their stored unit/epoch contracts.
Selected products publish immutable HDF5/figure bundles; the legacy full suite
retains its separate entry point. Numerical arrays, support masks and missing
measurements are authoritative; plots do not supply absent physics.
See docs/architecture.md for the pipeline and docs/calculations.md for equations.

functions.name: solve_periodic_peculiar_potential
functions.description:
Periodic peculiar Phi in (km/s)^2, without the homogeneous source.

∇_x² Phi = 4πG a² rho_bar(proper) delta, x in comoving kpc.
Proper acceleration = -∇_x Phi/a; proper Hessian = ∂x_i∂x_j Phi/a².
The DC mode is zero. Odd meshes avoid Nyquist derivative ambiguity.
Gaussian smoothing acts on the source; there is no CIC deconvolution.

functions.name: classify_eigenstructure
functions.description: T-web classification from the FULL signed tensor, never trace-free.

functions.name: sample_periodic_tensor_grid
functions.description: Trilinear Cartesian tensor interpolation; eigensystems are fit AFTER it.

functions.name: measure_periodic_filament_regions
functions.description:
Six-connected class-2 voxel regions, including periodic face joins.

These are threshold-defined regions, not a ridge skeleton, unique physical
filament ancestry, or the 1DREAM extraction used in the alignment paper.

functions.name: measure_filament_proximity
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: measure_filament_axis_alignment
functions.description:
Alignment to unoriented filament axes; no preferred spine direction exists.

Unsupported axes may be missing; a supported direction must be finite and
nonzero. Zero-amplitude vectors remain unresolved, including degenerate
shape orientations explicitly supplied as zero by the source consumer.

functions.name: measure_spin_shape_filament_angles
functions.description: T-web-specific adapter; topology-based axes retain separate definitions.

functions.name: uncertainty_aware_log_density_derivative
locate_supported_slope_feature
functions.description:
Detect ambiguous valleys, quantify radius/depth/half-depth width.

The operational baseline is the lower of the adjacent shoulders, and width
is measured in ln r at half prominence. This is recorded separately from
the paper's parametric turnover-based depth and width definition.

functions.name: filament_transverse_profiles
functions.description:
Sample the unsmoothed scientific grid in tangent-normal planes.

Grid origin is the position of element [0,0,0], not a guessed cell edge.
Return the complete angle/radius samples and a declared half-excess diameter.
Background is the mean over the supplied outer annulus. Off-axis peaks,
rebounds, unresolved crossings and excluded junctions have no reported width.
This geometric estimator does not certify field or topology convergence.

functions.name: measure_filament_graph
functions.description:
Geometry of declared native arcs; topology is never inferred from rounding.

Arc images are explicit integer offsets. Returned distances are comoving
Mpc/h. Curvature is inverse comoving Mpc/h, with endpoints unresolved.

functions.name: nearest_filament_segments
functions.description:
Periodic projections retaining nearest distinct-arc alternatives.

Candidate rank is deterministic (native segment order breaks exact ties).
Missing ranks use -1 indices, NaN measurements and a false support mask.
Ambiguity is a geometric diagnostic, never a probabilistic membership.

functions.name: read_bound_filament_graph
functions.description:
Read sealed raw topology for the exact run/epoch used by a consumer.

Smoothed VTK display paths are deliberately not a scientific input. The
caller pins the publication manifest; every retained asset remains sealed.

functions.name: compare_first_apocenter_particles
functions.description:
First saved infall, first pericenter and subsequent first apocenter.

Missing detections break orbital support. Close pairs of samples alone do
not prove passage. Event timing is bracketed by actual saved proper times;
no inferred simulation outputs or ID-row continuity are manufactured.

functions.name: compare_continuous_first_apocenters
functions.description: First passage events using proper-radius Hermite derivatives; no cadence certification.

functions.name: orbital_event_arrays
functions.description:
Pack continuous events with exact identities and explicit graph-key brackets.

Namespace indices address the report's frozen table; IDs alone never name
hosts. Only supported first apocenters enter the aggregation mask.

functions.name: compare_native_first_apocenters
functions.description: Graph-bound host observations, exact particles, and CLASS proper clocks.

functions.name: measure_radial_environment
functions.description:
Mass-weight actual shell locations; diagonalize the mean full tensor.

The retained tensor scatter is spatial variation, not uncertainty in a
particle bootstrap or proof of environmental resolution convergence.

functions.name: discover_snapshot_sets

Do not merge files merely because their snapshot numbers match: a parent

rooted at the common directory containing its flat snapshots or its
``snapdir_NNN`` snapshot directories.  Requiring one such root makes a
broad parent-folder selection fail closed instead of fabricating a time
series from separate simulations.

functions.name: validate_gadget_snapshot_set
functions.description:
Validate cosmological GADGET-4 shards for this periodic-box analyzer.

Isolated snapshots use the domain readers with their declared native time

functions.name: read_particle_fields
functions.description:
Read aligned particle fields using one reproducible row sample.

Every requested field for a particle type is indexed by the same rows in
each HDF5 shard. Fields absent from every non-empty shard return as None;
inconsistent field availability or lengths across shards is an error rather
than a silently truncated or misaligned result. When requested, the second
return value gives each sampled row its inverse-inclusion weight, so sums
and profiles remain unbiased when integer shard allocations differ.

functions.name: gadget_matter_power_spectrum
functions.description:
Return GADGET's CIC-deconvolved spectrum with raw, shot, signal, and Gaussian-error terms.

The reported diagonal Gaussian mode-counting uncertainty is
sqrt(2/N_modes) times the shot-included power.  Shot noise is subtracted
from the signal estimate but retained in this variance.  This approximation
excludes non-Gaussian covariance, fold-systematics, and resolution error.

functions.name: ic_species_density_reference
functions.description:
Read explicitly named density columns; velocity is never delta_m.

Generator v1 has five columns and no total density column. The separate
validation reference has eight columns with an explicit delta_m. These
schemas must not be inferred from an arbitrary numeric column count.

functions.name: validate_ic_power_spectrum
functions.description: Compare a GADGET IC spectrum with its matching linear-theory target.

functions.name: validate_ic_species_power_spectra
functions.description:
Check hydro species spectra with a familywise false-rejection bound.

The configured IC-power false-rejection probability is the bound for the
complete two-species gate. Bonferroni allocation keeps the bound valid
whether or not the baryon and dark-matter estimates are correlated.

The hinge basis keeps each broken line continuous. BIC = chi^2 + k ln(N)
counts fitted coefficients and knot locations; supplied log-mass errors
define chi^2. A better two-knot fit prevents claiming a single transition.

functions.description:

For peculiar line-of-sight v in km/s, the comoving displacement is

no-h comoving box. Simulation epoch H is omitted from estimator metadata.

functions.description:
Draw the authored survey window, not uniformly in radial distance.

The radial CDF integrates n(r)*r^2 by trapezoids on the supplied grid and
interpolates that recorded cumulative selection. A common density/length
scale cancels from its normalization. Sky cells are weighted by solid
angle times completeness, then sampled uniformly in RA and sin(dec).

functions.name: apply_recorded_bao_reconstruction
functions.description:

RecSym shifts data and randoms by displacement+RSD; RecIso shifts randoms
by displacement alone. The particle iterative algorithm requires the
special 'data' lookup to evaluate shifts at reconstructed data positions.
See the bundled pyrecon read_shifted_positions interfaces.

functions.name: pycorr_measurement
functions.description:
Count xi(s,mu) using aligned data/random/shifted catalogues in Mpc.

pycorr position_type='pos' accepts (N,3), as declared by the bundled counter.
Shifted weights and exact identities must match the supplied randoms; a
same-shaped reconstruction from another catalogue cannot be substituted.

functions.name: fit_anisotropic_bao_template
functions.description:
Fit transverse/radial BAO dilation, profiling seven linear nuisances.

C is the supplied independent-mock covariance in separation-major, mu-minor
order. Cholesky whitening and least squares profile amplitude/broadband
terms without normal equations. The finite-mock likelihood is either the
declared Student-t form or Hartlap-corrected Gaussian. Curvature errors are
local approximations, not samples or demonstrated coverage.

Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton: 4*pi*alpha*G^2*M^2*rho/(cs^2+vrel^2)^1.5.
Eddington inflow: f_Edd*4*pi*G*M*m_p/(epsilon_r*sigma_T*c).

zero-momentum, zero-angular-momentum bath velocity degrees of freedom.

functions.name: proper_time_numerical_envelope
functions.description:
Bound linear-t interpolation relative to a declared piecewise-linear H(a).

CLASS H is in 1/Mpc with c=1; physical H [s^-1] = c[cm/s] H/Mpc[cm].
Anchor t at the first supplied proper-time row. On an interval H=H0+s(a-a0),
f=dt/da=1/(a H), t''=-1/(a^2 H)-s/(a H^2).
Positive endpoint H and a supply conservative absolute derivative bounds.
Linear interpolation error <= max|t''| delta_a^2/8. Source-node residuals
against integrated H and accumulated quadrature errors are also retained.
This bounds the declared tabulated model, not the unknown continuum H or
solver/systematic accuracy. QUADPACK errors are numerical estimates.

functions.description:

This integrates the standard pressureless second-order growth equation using
CLASS D1, f1, H, and Omega_m. The early boundary uses the EdS asymptote at
the first CLASS sample with Omega_m >= 0.8 (or the earliest sample if no
such point exists). It is not a scale-dependent EDE/WDM perturbation solver.

Columns are ``a, H(a)/H0, D(a)/D(1), f(a)``.  The table keeps every CLASS
sample between the requested early-time bound and today, with exact rows
inserted at both endpoints.  GADGET uses log-linear interpolation in a.

functions.name: smooth_particle_growth_history
functions.description:
Return normalized D(a) and f(a) for the smooth cold-particle model.

CLASS's default background growth helper omits non-cold relics from its
pressureless source. That is appropriate for its free-streaming transfer
calculation, but not for this project's explicitly cold-particle WDM
evolution after the transfer cutoff has been applied. The particle solver
evolves all matter as cold after the IC epoch, so its growth table uses the
radiation-aware smooth matter ODE with the WDM density included in Omega_m.

functions.name: smooth_particle_growth_rate
functions.description: Return f=d ln D/d ln a for the smooth cold-particle growth model.

functions.description:

The relic temperature follows the same CLASS ncdm normalization as
``wdm_parameters``. CLASS defines the distribution in comoving momentum
q=p/(k_B T_ncdm T_gamma,0); physical momentum is q k_B T_0/a. The exact
special-relativistic momentum-to-speed relation is used. GADGET-4's HDF5
IC convention stores u=v_pec/sqrt(a), as documented in its snapshot manual.
See CLASS explanatory.ini (massive relic input) and GADGET-4 snapshot format.

its scale-independent growing-mode velocity by the exact run-matched

This validation table is not consumed directly by an IC generator. Its raw

a separate staging function can convert it to the monofonIC plugin format.

functions.name: write_monofonic_ic_transfer_table

The tabulated fields are the run-matched linear density contrasts and
velocity divergences at the IC epoch. They are deliberately kept in CLASS
units here; the pinned monofonIC plugin applies its documented
``-T(k)/k^2`` convention and A_s normalization when evaluating them.

functions.name: write_monofonic_background_table
functions.description:
Write the full CLASS/AxiCLASS smooth background and linear growth for LPT.

The table extends to the radiation-era regular seed epoch used by the
monofonIC growth integrator, not only to the requested simulation start.
This lets its higher-order growth ODE use the selected H(a). For WDM the
transfer cutoff comes from CLASS, while particle growth after the IC epoch
treats those particles as cold and uses the matching smooth-matter ODE.

functions.name: run_external_pk
functions.description:

Supported inputs are CLASS-style linear P(k) tables and two-column
N-GenIC-style log10(k), log10(Delta^2) tables.  The redshift is mandatory;
the requested IC start redshift must match it exactly so we never silently
extrapolate a spectrum with an assumed growth law.

functions.name: wdm_resolution_report
functions.description:

The report applies to both supported WDM models; particle velocities and
their exact representation are recorded separately.

functions.name: match_wdm_cutoff_coverage
functions.description:
Extend paired CLASS output until it brackets the WDM half-mode cutoff.

The required particle mesh may have a Nyquist scale below the physical WDM
half-mode k. Reporting the cutoff requires extending both linear spectra;
extrapolating beyond their shared tabulated range would hide an unknown.

functions.name: validate_wdm_resolution_gate
functions.description: Stop an underresolved WDM evolution unless the config explicitly labels it a benchmark.

functions.name: validate_pk
functions.description: Check the positive, ordered k/P grid and requested physical coverage before downstream use.

functions.name: convert_pk_to_ngenic
functions.description:
Convert conventional CLASS P(k) into GADGET-4's N-GenIC table.

CLASS uses the Fourier convention with Delta^2 = k^3 P(k)/(2*pi^2).
GADGET-4's N-GenIC table is documented as 4*pi*k^3*P_gadget, where its
internal P_gadget is smaller than the conventional P(k) by (2*pi)^3.
Therefore the value written to N-GenIC is the conventional dimensionless
spectrum, k^3 P_CLASS/(2*pi^2), not 4*pi*k^3 P_CLASS.

The CLASS ``format = class`` output uses k[h/Mpc] and P[(Mpc/h)^3].

functions.name: lpt_rms_displacement_fraction
functions.description:
Return exact discrete-box 1-D rms linear displacement / particle spacing.

This sums the CLASS spectrum over the Fourier modes represented by the
configured periodic particle mesh. It excludes super-box and unresolved
modes instead of integrating an infinite-volume spectrum outside the run's
actual mode set.

AUTO evaluates the actual CLASS/AxiCLASS P(k,z) and iterates until the 1-D
rms displacement is in the configured fraction of one particle spacing.
This avoids blindly hard-coding z=49/99 while keeping the criterion visible.

functions.name: choose_start_redshift
functions.description: Select the model-matched IC epoch from the configured displacement criterion and allowed redshift range.

functions.description: W(kR)=3[sin(kR)-kR cos(kR)]/(kR)^3; W(0)=1 without cancellation.

functions.description: R=[3M/(4 pi rho_m,0)]^(1/3) in Mpc/h, with positive inputs.

functions.name: compute_sigma_and_dlnsigma
functions.description:
Integrate sigma and -dln(sigma)/dln(M) over the supplied linear P(k).

sigma^2 = integral Delta^2(k) W(kR)^2 dln(k). The derivative is evaluated
under the same integral, avoiding a derivative of a sparse mass spline.
dW/dln(R)=3 sin(kR)/(kR)-3W and dln(R)/dln(M)=1/3.
Endpoint coverage is required for every smoothing radius. A shape-preserving
log interpolation samples only inside the supplied k interval.

functions.name: f_sheth_tormen
functions.description: Dimensionless f(sigma); equation 10 of Sheth & Tormen (1999).

functions.name: f_tinker_2008
functions.description: Tinker eqs. 3-8 and Table 2 for SO 200m, without mass-definition switching.

functions.name: evaluate_theoretical_hmf
functions.description:
Return differential abundance and a cumulative integral with a finite upper mass.

dn/dln(M) = rho_m,0/M * f(sigma) * [-dln(sigma)/dln(M)]. Multiply by
ln(10) for dn/dlog10(M). The cumulative is integral_M^Mmax, where Mmax
is explicitly returned; it is never described as an integral to infinity.

The owning consumer must validate and hash-bind the complete snapshot set

Retired type-5 carriers remain explicitly marked, never counted as live BHs.

For r=a(x-x_origin), dr/dt=v_pec-v_origin+H*r. The caller supplies
recorded spatial images before this conversion. This function does not
infer winding, change identities, rotate frames, or convert native v.
H uses km/s/Mpc; r uses proper kpc; the output uses km/s.

fof_finish_group_properties stores mass-averaged canonical a*v_pec in
GroupVel; subfind_properties divides internal velocity by a before storing
SubhaloVel. SubhaloSpin uses proper native-length offsets crossed with
peculiar velocity (the radial Hubble term has zero cross product).

These two conversions need no a or h: kpc/h -> Mpc/h and

Metadata validation belongs to the saved-input reader; this does not infer
a unit convention from values, box size, or filenames.

description:
Native GADGET configuration, IC handoffs, execution and frozen-run recovery.

This module translates explicit physical/numerical settings into compiled
features and runtime parameters, binds exact linear/IC inputs, records native
execution and verifies checkpoint continuation. It does not make scientific
measurements from snapshots; that belongs to analysis and domain readers.
Historical logical sections remain registered in configs/core_source_layout.json.

description:
Native first-cooling/birth analysis and resolved-cloud products.

Cooling uses recorded radiative losses, not temperature decline alone. Jeans
support uses proper density, temperature and measured smoothing; effective-EOS
or missing chemistry cannot establish primordial fragmentation or an IMF.
Births retain exact gas-parent/host ancestry and saved proper-time brackets.

functions.name: primordial_cloud_support
functions.description:
Evaluate whether the recorded physics permits primordial cloud measurements.

capabilities supplies enabled process names or source-bound native boolean
switches. streaming declares its IC mode, proper-km/s convention, phase
provenance and reference scale factor. request is retained as the requested
resolution policy. Return a support decision with missing processes and
specific rejection reasons. Invalid native source bindings raise ValueError.
The calculation reads hashes and metadata and writes no files.

functions.name: gas_resolution_diagnostics
functions.description:
Evaluate thermal Jeans support in the original native gas census.

c_s^2 = gamma*k_B*T/(mu*m_H), lambda_J = c_s*sqrt(pi/(G*rho)),
M_J = (pi/6)*rho*lambda_J^3. Intermediate units are cgs; outputs use
km/s, proper kpc and Msun. Resolution compares M_J with neighbor-kernel
mass and lambda_J with measured smoothing, not particle separation.

functions.name: identify_cooling_events
functions.description: Track exact gas IDs and integrated native radiative losses between epochs.

functions.name: join_births_and_assembly
functions.description: Native gas->SSP ancestry and actual host ownership join at birth epoch.

functions.name: cloud_morphology
functions.description:
Measure connected gas candidates and their mass-weighted spatial moments.

gas supplies aligned proper-kpc positions, solar masses, density, temperature,
composition, smoothing lengths and availability masks at one saved epoch.
request fixes Jeans support, density threshold, link radius, particle/edge
budgets and minimum shape eigenvalue. support is the primordial physics gate.

Filter the original gas census by Jeans resolution and density, construct a
cKDTree neighbor graph, and measure each sufficiently populated component.
For a periodic box, unwrap the local component around a measured member and
reject ambiguous half-box extents. Covariance eigenvectors give principal
axes and square roots of eigenvalues give RMS lengths in proper kpc.

Return (report, arrays). The report contains status, cloud centroids, masses,
axes and shape masks. Arrays retain particle selection, Jeans diagnostics,
selected coordinates, masses and exact IDs when supplied. Unsupported physics
returns an empty array mapping. An insufficient selection returns diagnostics
with an unresolved status. This function writes no files.

functions.name: first_star_inputs
functions.description:
Load a sealed first-star environment product within the memory budget.

product is its JSON report path. Verify its numeric archive, source hashes,

products raise before figure construction. This intake writes no files.

functions.name: first_star_timeline_arrays
functions.description:
Validate event identities and saved times, then construct timeline arrays.

report is the original first-star environment report and arrays is its loaded
numeric payload. Require Myr time units, exact equality between event-row and
array times, valid cooling brackets and consistent birth/assembly brackets.
Check that the reported first birth is the earliest retained joined birth.

Return (display_arrays, identity_namespaces). Cooling and birth ordinates are
categorical zero and one. uint64 gas/stellar IDs, interval endpoints and
resolved/unresolved cooling masks remain aligned with the original events.
The function writes no files and estimates no event rates.

functions.name: export_native_first_star_figures
functions.description:
Publish the registered cooling/birth timeline from an original measurement.

Load product with first_star_inputs and validate it with
first_star_timeline_arrays. Create a fresh destination containing the sealed
numeric bridge and an organized gallery of PNG, PDF, SVG, plotted NPZ arrays
and figure metadata. Cooling times use saved interval ends in Myr and births
use their recorded applied times. Resolved and unresolved cooling appear as
separate series. Empty event populations remain empty.

Return the scientific-suite gallery result. Existing destinations, stale
source bindings or inconsistent event arrays raise before successful export.

functions.name: cloud_figure_inputs
functions.description:
Load an original cloud product and verify its estimator provenance.

Accept measured, unsupported-physics and unresolved-selection statuses. Read
product within memory_gib and verify the numeric archive plus the current
first_stars estimator checksum. Return (report, arrays, source_hashes).
Malformed schemas, statuses or changed sources raise ValueError.

functions.name: cloud_display_arrays
functions.description:
Extract proper Cartesian cloud positions and preserve original shape support.

report and arrays come from cloud_figure_inputs. For measured products,
validate units, finite 3D points, cloud centroids, RMS axes, principal axes,
boolean shape masks and optional exact particle-ID namespaces. Return separate
gas_x/y/z and center_x/y/z arrays, supported/unresolved centroid masks and
original uint64 IDs when available. Unsupported products return empty geometry.
A product that claims measured points despite unsupported status raises.
No coordinate conversion, fitting or file output occurs here.

functions.name: export_native_cloud_figures
functions.description:

product supplies the original measurement and saved epoch. destination must
be new. After cloud_display_arrays validates geometry, write a sealed bridge
and PNG, PDF, SVG, plotted arrays and figure metadata through the scientific
suite. Gas positions and centroid positions use proper kpc. Original shape
support controls the centroid series, and absent particle identity remains
explicit in the metadata. Return the gallery result.

description:
Host motion, reconstructed fields and extended gravity components.

Hermite motion uses recorded proper velocities. Proper cosmological center
velocities must include Hubble motion before entering this interface. Forces
are evaluated in the inertial frame, avoiding omitted fictitious forces.

Fields return Phi [(km/s)^2], acceleration [(km/s)^2/proper kpc], and
the potential Hessian [(km/s)^2/proper kpc^2]; the tidal tensor is -H(Phi).

functions.name: HostFrame
functions.description:
Move between measured body coordinates and a common inertial frame.

Positions are proper kpc, velocities km/s and times Myr. R maps column
body vectors into inertial vectors. For the row arrays used here,
x_inertial = x_body R.T + center and
v_inertial = (v_body + omega_body cross x_body / K) R.T + center_velocity,
where K converts km/s to kpc/Myr. The rotation term is essential even
when the body's origin is stationary.

functions.name: SatelliteWorldline
functions.description: Recorded extended Plummer perturber; no inferred point-mass substitute.

functions.name: TimeDependentHost
functions.description:
Interpolate measured body-frame fields, then return inertial forces.

Forces and Hessians transform as a_global = R a_body and
H_global = R H_body R.T. Integrating in the inertial frame avoids adding
Coriolis/centrifugal terms. Temporal field interpolation is a declared
approximation inside measured support, not a convergence certificate.

functions.name: RadialProfile
functions.description:
Measured enclosed mass with finite-mass exterior and declared inner core.

A monotone cubic mass interpolant gives rho=M'/(4 pi r^2). The potential
is computed from the same M, not an independently fitted NFW potential.
The outer truncation is the last measured radius. Central extrapolation
is permitted only via the explicit constant-density-core assumption.

functions.name: EvolvingPerturber
functions.description:
Interpolate actual epoch forces/potentials, preserving disruption flags.

Each profile carries its own measured epoch mass, matched to the worldline.
Interpolating potential, force and Hessian with the SAME weight retains
their derivative relationships; zero-mass epochs contribute zero gravity.

functions.name: DifferentiatedPotential
functions.description:
Consistent scalar-field finite differences for analytic nonradial models.

The derivative spacing is a recorded numerical parameter; it must receive
independent refinement controls. It is never a softening length.
The deformed Plummer bar is an imposed potential family; it is not a
Ferrers density model or a guarantee of positive density at every radius.

functions.name: spherical_velocity_variances
functions.description:
Return mass-weighted (var(v_r), var(v_theta), var(v_phi)).

Offsets and velocities share the declared halo rest frame. The polar axis
is simulation z; on its poles use e_phi=(0,1,0). Subtract each spherical
component's measured mean, so ordered rotation is not random dispersion.
Results have squared velocity units. A particle at the origin has no
spherical basis; such a selection, or an empty one, returns three NaNs.
Dispersion-based beta convention:
https://docs.galpy.org/en/v1.12.0/tutorials/distribution_functions/spherical_dfs.html

functions.description:
Complete proper shell census, population covariance and enclosed spin.

Velocities are peculiar, relative to the explicit host bulk velocity.
Vc is the spherical-equivalent sqrt(G M(<r)/r), including for a disk.
Poisson density errors are mass shot noise, not physical convergence.

functions.name: direct_host_field
functions.description:
Independent isolated Newtonian Phi, acceleration and signed Hessian.

This is the unsoftened finite particle source used by the expansion.
The sign is H_ij = d_i d_j Phi; acceleration = -grad(Phi).
It is never a cosmological periodic or mean-density-subtracted solve.

functions.name: radiation_growing_history
functions.description:
Solve the regular pressureless growing mode in the supplied background.

CLASS's background dust-growth initial condition need not be the regular
Mészáros mode. It is not used as an implicit higher-order seed here. The
actual H(a) remains unchanged, including any later smooth EDE contribution.
This is a pressureless common-flow model, not a Boltzmann species transfer.

functions.name: second_order_growth
functions.description:
Integrate E_xx+(2+H_x/H)E_x-3/2 Omega_m E=-3/2 Omega_m D².

x=ln(a); H may use any consistent units. D and f are solver-supplied;
normalization cancels in E/D². Seeds are explicit: an early radiation
Mészáros series, a declared EdS limit, or caller-supplied (E,E_x). EDE
callers must establish the seed regime or supply its growing solution.
No LCDM H(a) or fixed -3/7 kernel is substituted for the supplied history.

functions.name: evolve_twofluid_relative_modes
functions.description:
Finite-epoch second-order Euler/Poisson and Lagrangian characteristic expansion.

u = h*v_pec/(a*H) is comoving Mpc/h per ln(a). Both species retain
independent linear densities/velocities and all quadratic convective
couplings. Second-order data are explicit finite-epoch seeds, not guessed
fastest-growing modes. Pressure is either zero or a declared homogeneous
isothermal baryon sound-speed history. Shell crossing is outside scope.

functions.name: evolve_twofluid_nonlinear_reference
functions.description:
Conservative finite-volume Euler/Poisson reference without PT truncation.

rho_s=1+delta_s; u_s=h*v_s/(a*H); momentum=rho_s*u_s.
The periodic Rusanov flux and SSPRK3 retain full advective products.
This is a single-stream fluid reference, not collisionless phase-space
evolution after shell crossing, a gas energy solver, or a native IC map.

functions.name: false_discovery_control
functions.description:
Return the FDR selection mask and adjusted probabilities in input order.

For sorted p_(i), q_(i) = min_{j >= i}(n*c_n*p_(j)/j), capped at one.
Benjamini--Yekutieli uses c_n = sum(1/i) for arbitrary dependence;
c_n = 1 is Benjamini--Hochberg and requires independent or suitably
positively dependent null tests. Both p and the requested rate are unitless.

functions.name: discover_outliers

Values and reference means share one physical unit; each variance has its
square. The additive error model assumes the three error contributions
have no cross covariance: z = (value - mean) / sqrt(sum(variances)).
Empirical controls must be comparable independent standardized residuals.
Selection weights describe inclusion/abundance, not a correction to null
probabilities. FDR selection identifies candidates, not confirmed physics.

description:
MUSIC planning, numerical operators, response propagation and noise models.

Consumers import their selected module explicitly. Package import does not
build native software, load its libraries, or run scientific calculations.

Adjoints from MUSIC windows through potentials, sources and shared noise.

For real arrays the transpose preserves <w, F(x)> = <F.T(w), x>. Potentials
include supported ghost cells; source weights retain their actual hierarchy.
The coupled inverse uses its explicit gauge. Gas, DM and compensation responses
must be added on the SAME noise variables before covariance is evaluated.
No transpose or solver residual establishes a physical field-error bound.

functions.name: finite_gradient_adjoint
functions.description:
Scatter the real gradient response onto potential and ghost cells.

Each forward +/- stencil sample receives the corresponding signed weight
times 2**level, since normalized box spacing is 2**(-level). Ghost weights
remain explicit; dropping them would change the transpose identity.

functions.name: hybrid_correction_adjoint
functions.description:
Real transpose of periodic vector hybrid response in grid-cell units.

Full complex transforms provide independent Hermitian bookkeeping from
the forward half-spectrum implementation. Each differentiated Nyquist
plane is zero; other components on that plane are retained.

functions.name: sampled_hierarchy_source_adjoint
functions.description:
Transpose the bounded native hierarchy source-reconstruction model.

Returns weights for each supplied scalar source grid. Repeated periodic
indices accumulate, overwritten fine cells have no parent interpolation
response, and cell-average preparation restriction is transposed as well.
No global finest-level field is constructed.

functions.name: gradient_hierarchy_adjoint
functions.description:
Transpose captured-potential FD plus bounded hybrid gradient assembly.

Source and potential are distinct inputs here. Returned potential weights
explicitly retain boundary/ghost dependence; no independence of those
potentials and the source/noise is assumed for a covariance calculation.

functions.name: potential_source_response
functions.description:
Transpose the gauge-fixed coupled solve for a gauge-invariant window.

If A*phi = B*source and the window is w.T*phi, solve A.T*lambda=w;
then B.T*lambda gives the source coefficients. B includes grid-spacing
scaling and the explicit covered/gauge rows.

The returned source coefficients may be used only when status is PASS.
Solver convergence is not a certificate of continuum boundary accuracy.
No potential samples or ghost cells are independent random variables.

functions.name: flow_source_noise_response
functions.description:
Combine species preparations on their SAME cached-noise variables.

source_weights: preparation(0/1)->level->real weights, after the coupled
potential transpose and direct hybrid/source contributions are combined.
compensation_weights: preparation->finest weights on the native already
species-weighted compensation field. Their factors are applied once.
The result contains no assumed covariance or boundary-error acceptance.

description:
Retained native MUSIC fields, hierarchy loading and discrete comparisons.

The archive keeps sources before their solves and solved potentials with
actual ghost cells. Indexing checks bytes and finite values, not whether a
field has correct physical boundaries or transfer normalization. The operator
comparisons below keep those questions separate from discrete agreement.

functions.name: archive_precision_sources
functions.description: Bind wider arithmetic when this archive actually contains wider fields.

functions.name: potential_weighted_sum
functions.description: Accumulate real potential weights without downcasting binary128 input.

functions.name: index_music_source_archive
functions.description:
Check every field and finite scalar, retaining bounded payload offsets.

Ghost cells are retained for solved potentials only. Source fields are
captured before their solves and have no assumed valid ghost population.
Sampling semantics and the link to the generated IC are separate checks.

functions.name: load_music_source_hierarchy
functions.description: Read selected immutable interiors or explicit native ghost grids.

functions.name: quadratic_source_from_potential
functions.description:
Independent Hessian invariant before native restriction/DC projection.

In dimensionless box coordinates the source is
sum over i<j of (Phi_ii * Phi_jj - Phi_ij**2). Each grid derivative brings
a factor 2**level; do not insert another box-length conversion here.

Native order 2 composes centred second-order first derivatives. Native
orders 4 and 6 both compose fourth-order first derivatives for this source.
The spectral path zeros complete Nyquist planes, matching the declared
native operator rather than adding a different alias/zero-mode policy.

functions.name: poisson_source_from_potential
functions.description:
Evaluate source = -L Phi in native dimensionless box coordinates.

A grid spacing h = 2**(-level) gives the finite Laplacian its 1/h**2
factor. A constant potential is a gauge choice and contributes no source.
Use actual captured ghosts for nested grids; only a full box may use FFTs.

functions.name: quadratic_hierarchy_from_potentials
functions.description:
Replay composed derivatives, child restriction and global base DC.

This checks implementation against actual captured potentials. The solved
potential and its boundary values still require an independent reference.

functions.name: audit_music_archive_quadratic_source
functions.description: Publish measured per-species/level agreement with the source operator.

functions.name: hierarchy_leaf_support
functions.description: Rectangular Poisson leaves; independent of the particle-output mask.

functions.name: audit_music_archive_poisson
functions.description:
Check the original prepared source against -L Phi on actual leaves.

Uses the unchanged configured multigrid relative tolerance. It never fits
away a residual mean or substitutes the mutated FAS source for the input.
This checks equations using actual potential ghosts; an independent
potential/boundary reference is still required for physical acceptance.

functions.name: audit_native_quadratic_velocity
functions.description:
Measure v2 = (D2' / D2) aH Psi2 in each species/hierarchy window.

The 1e-7 assembly tolerance and 1e-6 native component signal floors are
retained from the existing native quadratic/unit regression controls.

description:
Build and use MUSIC's native flux-matched boundary map and transpose.

The build is explicit and source-bound. The operator maps complete padded

native call or adjoint comparison alone does not certify physical boundary
accuracy. Importing this module does not compile or load a native library.

functions.name: NativeBoundaryOperator
functions.description:
Actual native flux-matched ghost map and its real Euclidean transpose.

Inputs retain both complete coarse/fine potential interiors and ghosts.
Output indices are only the axis-aligned ghost faces touched by the
declared Laplacian stencil. They do not include an inferred boundary
accuracy or treat source/potential inputs as independent random variables.

functions.name: prepare_boundary_adapter
functions.description:
Compile the existing serial native operator; never regenerate ICs.

GCC and Clang builds use standard C++17 shared-library options. FFTW and
OpenMP headers must be available, even though this adapter does not run
threaded loops or FFTs. Extra include paths can be supplied explicitly.
Existing completed builds are reused only when their bindings verify.

description:
Verified MUSIC noise moments, window covariance and Gaussian checks.

Real response rows map the same native innovations to measured observables.
Full-frozen, fixed-parent and fixed-prefix local-seeded models stay explicit;
frozen bytes alone do not establish a Gaussian ensemble. Covariance retains
mixed channel units. Correlation and Gaussian checks use dimensionless scaling,
without regularization, eigenvalue clipping or physical-acceptance claims.

functions.name: frozen_noise_refine
functions.description:
Refine the declared full-periodic unit-Gaussian Meyer field.

The fine cube has eight times as many cells. With NumPy's FFT convention
the parent spectrum carries sqrt(8); a constant parent therefore becomes
parent/sqrt(8) in real fine cells. This is white-noise normalization,
not density interpolation or a fitted variance correction.

functions.name: frozen_noise_refine_adjoint
functions.description: Return coarse-field and independent-fine-draw response weights.

functions.name: frozen_hierarchy_innovation_response
functions.description:
Map simultaneous real cached-noise responses to independent raw draws.

responses[level] has shape (number_of_real_outputs, *cached_noise_shape).
Every periodic cache overlap accumulates onto its original full cube.
This route allocates the *frozen prefix* full cubes, never an unretained
effective finest production grid. A local seeded extension needs its own
declared covariance route and is intentionally rejected by callers.

functions.name: frozen_response_moments
functions.description:
Exact finite real covariance and conditional mean for this noise model.

For independent unit innovations z_l and real rows R_l, y=sum(R_l*z_l)
has C=sum(R_l*R_l.T). The ensemble base includes its zero-mean projector.
With fixed_parent, m=R_base*parent and covariance excludes that base draw.

With fixed_parent, the parent field is conditioned, not re-randomized.
Otherwise the base draw is projected to zero mean as in the native top
generator. No ridge, eigenvalue clipping or empirical variance fit occurs.

functions.name: condition_gaussian_observables
functions.description:
Condition explicit Gaussian linear observables, e.g. aperture mass.

With retained K and observed O, the conditional mean adds
C_KO solve(C_OO, observed-m_O); covariance subtracts
C_KO solve(C_OO, C_OK). Use solves, not an explicit matrix inverse.

The observed indices must be declared independently of the tested mode
residuals. For a mass-normalized window, include its mass contrast in the
joint response and condition on that measured mass; then the denominator
used in the mode response is fixed. No residual mean or variance is fit.
Singular/ill-conditioned blocks remain unresolved with the same1e12
default as the existing window Gaussian check; no ridge or clipping.

functions.name: NativeResponseRows
functions.description:
Persistent sequential member streams; no all-observable materialization.

Callers verify the numeric product and retain its input hashes before
opening this reader. File immutability is checked by the publication's
existing source bindings. This class handles only bounded array intake.

functions.name: validate_window_covariance_request
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: window_covariance_input_bindings
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: publish_compensated_window_covariance
functions.description:
Publish joint/conditioned finite moments; never authorize full evolution.

This consumes an exact response publication and a checksum-bound verified
native full-frozen model. Cache values must match that model's actual
full fields bitwise. Selected-mass rows are conditioned explicitly.

functions.name: verified_window_noise_moments
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: validate_flow_covariance_request
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: flow_covariance_input_bindings
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: publish_flow_window_covariance
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: flow_gaussian_blocks
functions.description:
Reuse the existing Gaussian test on each declared observable block.

Blocks group one window and one quantity across all requested modes.
Bonferroni controls the familywise false rejection for correlated blocks.
A full joint covariance may be singular because observables are redundant;
every tested block must independently meet the unchanged 1e12 criterion.

description:
MUSIC flow preparation, shared-noise responses and pre-evolution checks.

Preparation binds the selected physical answers to the actual native mesh.
Response publication carries density/velocity windows through the coupled
Poisson transpose onto the same noise cells for every species. The launch
check then uses the declared phase covariance and separate species/level
windows. Passing these discrete checks does not establish physical convergence
or continuum boundary accuracy. Native operators load only when requested.

functions.name: validate_flow_noise_request
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: flow_noise_input_bindings
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: publish_flow_noise_response
functions.description:
Map each measured density/velocity channel onto shared native noise.

For A phi = B source, a potential weight w contributes
B.T solve(A.T, w) to the source weights. Add the direct source term, then
transpose transfer/refinement onto the actual noise caches. Gas and dark
matter share those variables, so sum their responses before covariance.
Density channels are dimensionless; velocity-divergence channels use
km/s per comoving kpc/h. The saved row_units records this distinction.

functions.name: original_flow_model_bindings
functions.description: Verify current adapter and the explicitly selected native noise model.

functions.name: prepare_original_flow_answers
functions.description:
Bind physical answers and separate species/level windows to this mesh.

Resolution comes from the actual finest level, not an unrelated template.
Box length, starting epoch and hydro settings must already agree. This
saves inputs for the launch check; it neither runs nor approves evolution.

functions.name: native_flow_public_command_bindings
functions.description: Include nested adapter/model dependencies in evolution cache keys.

functions.name: validate_original_flow_launch_request
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: require_original_flow_coverage
functions.description: Require complete, separate species and each actual refinement level.

functions.name: native_original_flow_window_gate
functions.description:
Check the exact delivered IC's discrete windows before evolution.

Follow measurements -> coupled responses -> declared phase covariance ->
familywise Gaussian blocks. Every actual species/refinement population
needs its own complete window; a mixed total could hide a species error.
Failure or interruption preserves a diagnostic and prevents launch.

description:
Native MUSIC phase formats and explicit frozen/seeded model verification.

GRAFIC conversion preserves the selected sign, byte order and axes. Cache
encoding changes representation only. The two replay models have different
conditioning and must not substitute for one another; their source/seed/cache
bindings are checked before moment calculations consume the resulting model.
No format check or replay result establishes physical IC accuracy.

functions.name: read_frozen_grafic
functions.description:
Decode the declared GRAFIC marker/scalar width, sign and axis order.

Float32 samples promote exactly to float64; float64 samples retain their
values and sign bits unless the caller explicitly requests a sign flip.
The source file itself is never rewritten by this reader.

functions.name: publish_seeded_noise_model
functions.description:
Compare retained caches with replay, conditioning on the actual prefix.

Noise values are dimensionless. Only later levels draw new innovations;
the base cache must match the supplied frozen file bit for bit. The saved
moments describe this fixed-prefix model, not an ensemble of new prefixes.

functions.name: encode_parent_noise
functions.description:
Encode dimensionless cache samples as little-endian GRAFIC float64.

Each z plane is transposed to the native file's axis order, without changing
signs, normalization or random draws. Readback compares float64 bits,
including signed zero; the caller receives the input/output bindings.

functions.name: publish_frozen_noise_model
functions.description:
Replay a complete frozen hierarchy from its original disjoint seeds.

Unlike the local fixed-prefix model, this verifies the base draw too.
Canonical output fields retain the measured input samples, while saved
residuals compare them with independently reconstructed native noise.

description:
Coupled MUSIC Poisson equations, independent references and failure intake.

The coupled operator keeps leaf source equations and eight-child restriction
rows distinct. Whole-box Fourier and rational failed-field calculations keep
independent arithmetic: sharing production stencils would hide disagreement.
All coordinates here use the declared normalized box, not implicit kpc units.
Linear residuals and model sensitivity are not physical accuracy certificates.

functions.name: NativePoissonCoupling
functions.description:
Interior-potential operator with optional explicit zero-mean gauge.

Equations are scaled by h**2 on leaf cells, and by one on restriction
cells. With gauge=True, the first base leaf row is replaced by mean(Phi)
on the base grid. The removed physical equation must still be checked
against the original source after a solve; it is never fitted away.
Four parent interior cells of padding are required around each child.

functions.name: periodic_poisson_reference
functions.description:
Invert the declared negative finite Laplacian on a periodic cube.

Coordinates and potential use normalized box units. The DC compatibility
condition is checked against the unchanged declared relative tolerance
before inversion; the recorded roundoff DC is the only source projection.
The residual is evaluated in real space by an independent stencil.

functions.name: hierarchy_boundary_reference
functions.description:
Compare finest captured potential gradients to a whole-box reference.

Source reconstruction uses explicit conservative cell averages. Degree0
and degree5 are different source models; their difference must remain an
uncertainty, not an empirical acceptance allowance. No native potential
or native boundary value enters the independent Poisson solve.

functions.name: audit_music_archive_boundary
functions.description:
Publish measured boundary discrepancies for two explicit source models.

A successful computation is REFERENCE_MEASURED, never launch acceptance.
In particular the degree0/degree5 spread is not a bound on unrepresented
physical source modes or a license to expand a numerical tolerance.

functions.name: read_failure_snapshot
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: inspect_failure_snapshot
functions.description:
Measure R = finite_Laplacian(Phi) + source on the original leaf cells.

Fraction arithmetic represents the saved binary64 samples exactly. It
distinguishes changed source values from residual-evaluation roundoff;
it cannot prove that a different representable solution is impossible.

description:
Exact binary128 storage and its explicit native arithmetic adapter.

Retained fields stay as IEEE754 integer word pairs. NumPy longdouble is not
assumed to represent binary128, and there is no implicit float conversion or
precision fallback. The native reference builds only when its caller asks for
wide-field arithmetic; its derivative observables round to binary64 at output.

functions.name: Binary128Array
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: prepare_binary128_reference
functions.description:
Build/reuse the bounded reference in external runtime state.

Called only when actual wider-field arithmetic is requested. A compiler
supporting IEEE binary128 is required; there is no precision fallback.

functions.name: reference_binding_sources
functions.description: Current verified compiler/source/binary pins for numerical receipts.

functions.name: wide_derivative
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: wide_dot
functions.description: See implementation.

description:
Independent replay from native MUSIC noise to sources and IC components.

Signed physical transfers, Fourier refinement and gradients use the declared
native conventions. Captured sources/potentials are comparison inputs only
where explicitly stated. Discrete agreement does not establish continuum
accuracy, physical boundary conditions or a new statistical noise model.

functions.name: finite_gradient
functions.description:
Centred gradient with respect to dimensionless box coordinates.

At level L the spacing is h=2**(-L), so each derivative contributes 1/h.
Caller restores the physical box length or velocity-source length once.
Ghost values are actual inputs; this operator does not solve boundaries.

functions.name: hybrid_correction
functions.description:
Periodic cubic high-frequency correction in native grid-cell units.

The correction is continuum i*k/k^2 minus the discrete gradient/negative
Laplacian response. Only the differentiated Nyquist plane is removed.
Caller applies the native finest-level 2^-level length conversion.

functions.name: compensated_mass_reference
functions.description:
Native finite-window relative mode; preserve the supplied mean mass.

Returns the encoded binary64 mass, its encoded relative fluctuation and
the source-window mean. Nonpositive masses fail rather than being clipped.

functions.name: replay_gradient_hierarchy
functions.description:
Replay nested correction, native coarsening and base-only centring.

Explicitly preserves current coarsen_density behavior: restrict the finest
grid to its parent, then the full transfer base down to the Poisson base.
It does not silently replace that behavior by all-level restriction.

functions.name: audit_music_archive_gradients
functions.description:
Compare retained and quadratic displacements and first-order velocity.

Uses actual original material-cell centres, widths, box restoration and
background species fractions. Coarse particles combine both prepared
fluid fields; gas uses its own already staggered native source pass.

functions.name: convolve_noise_reference
functions.description:
Point-sampled Fourier convolution, with signed sqrt(P)-like amplitude.

amplitude(k) must include the physical transfer/primordial normalization,
but not sqrt(N/V). Native noise has unit cell variance. No cell window is
silently inserted. A positive shift evaluates the field at shifted nodes.
For N cells in volume V, sqrt(N/V) converts unit-variance cell noise
and the supplied sqrt(P) amplitude into the native Fourier convention.

functions.name: fourier_splice_reference
functions.description:
Native Meyer blend with point-centre quarter-coarse-cell phase shift.

coarse_start locates the footprint of the *padded* fine patch in the
actual parent array. Only the full base array may wrap periodically.

functions.name: dms_transfer_amplitude
functions.description:
Signed physical transfer amplitude using native natural splines in log k.

Returns sqrt(P) for density/relative density, and the corresponding
velocity-source amplitude in km/s per comoving Mpc/h. Start transfers
require identical target/start epochs, so no growth fit is introduced.

functions.name: replay_prepared_source
functions.description:
Replay actual padded hierarchy, Fourier splicing, cuts and leaf mean.

Supports the retained DMS default Fourier coarsening route with identical
transfer/Poisson base levels. The captured source does not enter replay.

functions.name: load_native_noise
functions.description: Read the native binary64 cached noise, validating geometry before load.

functions.name: transfer_replay_input_bindings
functions.description: Freeze all finite replay inputs before workflow cache/reuse decisions.

functions.name: audit_music_archive_transfer
functions.description:
Bind source replay to retained noise, mesh, transfer, IC and index bytes.

Uses the existing 1e-7 operator-agreement criterion. A pass establishes
original finite source assembly, not physical continuum/window accuracy.

description:
MUSIC hierarchy census and phase, response and solver allocation plans.

Cell/particle counts use the declared native geometry. Memory/disk figures use
bytes (MiB = 2**20 bytes), with explicit allocator/FFT allowances; estimates do
not establish measured peak memory or scientific resolution. Native boundary
operation counts are queried only when the selected caller requests them.

functions.name: native_boundary_count_profile
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: boundary_workspace
functions.description:
Count the native boundary tape and its existing allocation allowances.

Each padded grid has four ghost cells per face, hence product(n+8).
The compiled operation profile supplies arithmetic nodes per ghost/face;
allocator allowances remain provisioning estimates, not measured RSS.

functions.name: coupled_geometry
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: coupled_workspace_plan
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: source_response_resources
functions.description:
Budget real response channels, retained source grids, IDs and masks.

Each mode/window/quantity pair has two real channels. Potential scalars
retain their declared 8- or 16-byte precision; no downcast saves memory.

functions.name: noise_response_resources
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: hybrid_workspace_requirements
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: propose_hybrid_workspace
functions.description: Derive the minimum declared workspace from unchanged native bounds.

functions.name: estimate_music_phase_resources
functions.description:
Account for actual full-prefix and bounded seeded-subvolume paths.

Allocation payloads follow native shapes and tile visitation. Container,
GSL and FFT-internal overheads are explicit provisioning assumptions, not
measured peak RSS. No effective-finest full cube is allocated or needed
by this estimator or by the supported seeded-subvolume strategy.

functions.name: publish_music_phase_resources
functions.description: Size pinned retained native geometry without generating any field.

functions.name: phase_resources_main
functions.description: Plan native tiled phase memory and cache storage from retained geometry.

functions.name: rectangular_particle_census
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: native_header_count_requirements
functions.description: Bind the exact header encoding to native writer/reader source contracts.

functions.name: estimate_generation_handoff
functions.description:
Combine geometry-based generation and response allocations in bytes.

Stages run sequentially, so memory is their maximum. Their retained files
coexist, so disk is their sum. Proposed GiB allocations round upward after
the explicit provisioning factor; they are estimates, not measured RSS.
Evolution and saved snapshots use separate caller-supplied assumptions.

functions.name: publish_generation_capacity
functions.description: See implementation.

description:
MUSIC local seeded refinement, GSL replay and fixed-prefix moments.

The retained prefix is fixed. Subsequent raw tiles carry the declared global
mt19937 seeds and native Gaussian draws. Rectangular cache footprints preserve
periodic coordinates and inherited DC; they are not independent full cubes.
Moment calculation streams one observable at a time and accumulates a Gram
matrix on disk. Importing this module never loads GSL or draws a field.

functions.name: refine_patch
functions.description:
Blend dimensionless parent noise and independent fine-grid innovations.

Refinement doubles each axis (eight fine cells per coarse cell). The
sqrt(8) Fourier factor preserves the white-noise convention: a constant
parent contributes parent/sqrt(8) to each fine cell, not parent itself.
The phase aligns the native coarse and fine cell centers.

functions.name: refine_patch_adjoint
functions.description: Exact Euclidean transpose: parent footprint and raw fine draw weights.

functions.name: patch_geometry
functions.description: Native cache coordinates from the bound computational-to-box shift.

functions.name: parent_footprint_indices
functions.description: Locate every native coarse read in retained parent coordinates.

functions.name: raw_patch_layout
functions.description: Global mt19937 tile seeds and within-tile coordinates, axis factored.

functions.name: replay_raw_patch
functions.description: Replay actual GSL draws tile by tile; no effective finest full cube.

functions.name: hierarchy_response
functions.description:
Transpose one real observable, bounded by local patch sizes.

Returns fixed-prefix weights plus per-level innovation weights. Call once
per observable and persist rows to disk for a bounded Gram calculation.
Response count does not multiply the live FFT workspace.

functions.name: estimate_seeded_moments
functions.description: Explicit disk/FFT bounds; neither full finest cube nor all-row FFTs.

functions.name: stream_fixed_prefix_moments
functions.description:
Conditional mean/C of distinct local observables, without fitting.

The caller must independently bind native configuration, raw seeds, caches
and model provenance. This mathematical component does not certify them.
Innovations within a patch are unique periodic cell identities. Disjoint
native tile-seed intervals make the levels independent. Overlapping cases
require a separately constructed joint covariance model. This
single-hierarchy calculation does not establish cross-case independence.

functions.name: validate_seeded_covariance
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: verified_seeded_window_moments
functions.description: See implementation.

description:
Stage native MUSIC cases and bind evolution to their actual generated mesh.

Restaging preserves physical settings and phase inputs, with an explicit
optional start-epoch replacement. Generated-flow preparation uses the exact
new IC, source archive and mesh; it never substitutes an old generated field.
These functions prepare inputs. The separate native handoff and flow checks
still have to pass before evolution.

functions.name: restage_campaign_case
functions.description:
Recreate a case with explicit source retention and bounded corrections.

An optional replacement linear bundle may change the starting epoch and
its derived 2LPT coefficients. Every other physical parameter and phase
input must agree; restaging is not permission to change the cosmology.

functions.name: preflight_generated_flow_evolution
functions.description:
Inspect physical answers behind the registered runtime flow producer.

Returns False for other answer-materializer routes, which retain their
own preflight. It never creates future answers or substitutes static ones.

functions.name: generated_flow_bindings
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: prepare_generated_flow_answers
functions.description:
Build answers from this generation's retained IC and source archive.

If requested, verify the local phase model against the actual generated
cache coordinates first. A failed verification preserves its diagnostics
and prevents physical answer preparation. The public answer path stays
stable whether verification is supplied or performed here.

description:
Finite MUSIC particle-window measurements and their native input responses.

A window selects particles in the original Lagrangian frame. Density modes
are dimensionless; velocity divergence uses km/s per comoving kpc/h. Responses
follow the actual source hierarchy, retained potentials and padded caches.
Their agreement alone establishes neither a noise covariance nor physical
boundary accuracy; those require the separate declared model and controls.

functions.name: compensated_source_window_weights
functions.description:
Complex source weights for an original-q compensated mass window.

cells and q represent *all* delivered fine particles of one species.
Native compensation removes their full-population source mean, even when
window_weights selects only a subset. Mass normalization is explicit;
this does not substitute particle count for the actual window mass.

If delta_m = f * mean_mass * (source - full_population_mean), the mode
is sum(delta_m * selection * exp(-i k.q)) / actual_window_mass.
Subtracting the mean of the selected phase weights gives its transpose.

functions.name: convolve_noise_adjoint
functions.description: Real Euclidean adjoint of signed native convolution and staggering.

functions.name: fourier_splice_adjoint
functions.description:
Return parent/fine Euclidean responses of the native padded splice.

Fourier interpolation multiplies the parent spectrum by8; its adjoint
multiplies by1 because the fine inverse-transform volume is8 times larger.
The taper vanishes on every ambiguous coarse Nyquist boundary.

functions.name: prepared_source_adjoint
functions.description:
Push a real weighted sum of all source levels back to cached noise.

weights is a dict level->real array on the physical Poisson hierarchy.
Results have the actual padded noise shapes. DC, overwritten parent cells,
cut geometry, parent-mode dependence and gas staggering remain explicit.
This provides finite response rows; a covariance still requires the actual
correlated noise-generation model, not an identity covariance by default.

functions.name: validate_compensated_window_request
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: measure_native_compensated_windows
functions.description:
Publish mass-normalized modes and explicit mass-conditioning responses.

Does not assume a covariance model. Noise response rows retain every
actual cached level; their native correlations must be supplied separately.
For baryon fraction f_b, compensated gas masses use +(1-f_b) and dark
matter masses use -f_b, so the combined compensation conserves mass.

functions.name: validate_flow_window_request
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: measure_native_flow_windows
functions.description:
Replay full measured windows with separate source/potential coefficients.

Captured potential ghosts remain explicit inputs, not independent noise
variables or a physical boundary certificate. Density includes the native
fine-species compensated mass term; velocity uses retained first-order v.

With phase exp(-i k.q), density is -i k.Psi and velocity divergence is
+i k.v. Positions and k use comoving kpc/h; the native velocity source
uses comoving Mpc/h, so its reconstruction length differs by 1000.
Both observables divide by the actual selected total mass.

description:
Native software identity, staging, builds and owned process execution.

Builds stay outside the checkout. Presence and source identity do not establish
scientific capability; run-specific physics and acceptance remain with callers.

functions.name: native_engine_directory
functions.description: Locate an externally built engine; retain legacy discovery during migration.

functions.name: external_native_source
functions.description: Stage a source-bound copy for engines whose makefiles write in-tree.

functions.name: external_tool_inventory
functions.description:
Record discoverable solver/render tools and their reported versions.

A failed or unsupported ``--version`` probe remains unknown; executable
presence alone is not treated as proof of capability. Pinned source
revisions and build feature flags are recorded separately by run/build
manifests.

functions.name: build_engine
functions.description:
Build one native executable, without downloading redundant engines.

monofonIC receives tabulated species transfers from our CLASS run, so its
embedded CLASS and optional HACC GenericIO download paths are disabled.
CLASS's executable target avoids installing competing classy Python modules.

functions.name: native_run_lock
functions.description:
Fail promptly if another process/thread owns this run, including symlink aliases.

Lock files are outside the run so initial preparation still requires an empty
run directory. Kernel ownership, rather than the diagnostic PID, is authoritative.

functions.name: native_run_lock_fds
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: native_owned_fds
functions.description: Pass all nested current-thread owners to children of an isolated wrapper.

functions.name: native_run_owner
functions.description: Keep existing public signatures and nested native calls under one owner.

functions.name: directory_owner
functions.description: Reuse the same kernel ownership for non-run artifact producer/consumer roots.

functions.name: stop_owned_process_groups
functions.description: Terminate only new-session groups created by this wrapper, then reap parents.

functions.description: Bind the actual executable and explicit input files before spawning it.

functions.name: verify_invocation_inputs
functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: run_native_command
functions.description: Retain spawn/return/failure evidence and clean descendants on every exit.

functions.name: verified_python_backend
functions.description:
Verify a pinned VCS wheel or bootstrap's source-bound external installation.

Local wheels need the external install receipt plus exact declared source
and installed-file inventories. A local direct_url alone is insufficient.
Every returned source is tied to bytes on the current host.

functions.name: native_build_input_paths
functions.description:
Enumerate GADGET build inputs identically for builds and current receipts.

Typed restart .inc fragments and Random123 headers affect executable state
just as translation units do. Generated bytecode/build files are excluded.
Returned paths retain source-relative names for reproducible build hashing.

functions.name: native_particle_index_requirement
functions.description:
Return the necessary rank floor imposed by native local array indices.

If f is ALLOC_TOLERANCE, usable balanced capacity per rank is
floor((2^31-1)*(1-2*f)); ranks must be at least ceil(N/capacity).
Counts are exact integers, and Fraction preserves the allocation reserve
without floating rounding. This is an index-capacity limit, not a RAM,
domain-balance or scheduler-feasibility estimate.

description: Native baryon histories and cooling/birth/cloud recipes through existing estimators.

functions.name: baryon_figure_inputs
functions.description:
Validate the original hydro history and frozen six-figure design.

parameters names hydro_history, design_path, design_sha256 and memory_gib.
Verify gas phase-bin definitions, synthesis backend hashes and two distinct
color filters against the pinned FSPS model. Return the design settings,
hydro history report and combined source hashes. This performs bounded
intake and backend setup without exporting figures.

functions.name: native_baryon_figures_runner
functions.description:
Export six baryon-history recipes inside an owned workflow generation.

Read the sealed hydro history and frozen gas/synthesis design through
baryon_figure_inputs. Export gas phase, SFR, mass return, metal, luminosity
and color histories under context.generation. Population synthesis calls the
pinned FSPS backend selected by the design. Original support masks and native
accounting status remain in the output contracts.

Write baryon-figures.json with figure count, variants and source hashes and
return the same result mapping. Missing synthesis support, invalid designs
and insufficient stage memory raise before successful completion.

functions.name: native_resolution_fields
functions.description: Original native Hsml and exact saved ownership; never infer smoothing.

functions.name: cooling_birth_inputs
functions.description:
Bind a native gas history to its identity graph and host assembly product.

parameters supplies hydro_history, identity_graph, assembly_product and the
hash-bound cooling design. Verify the graph files, exact run and epoch
agreements, host branch keys, saved snapshots and numerical product sources.
Return hydro report, graph, assembly report, assembly arrays, design settings
and source hashes. These checks prevent mixing gas measurements from a
separate native run or assigning them to unrelated host observations.

functions.name: native_cooling_births_runner
functions.description:
Measure cooling, native birth ancestry and cloud geometry at saved epochs.

Load the inputs with cooling_birth_inputs, then read each original gas census
and measured smoothing lengths. Match native birth-journal IDs to graph
observations and join cooling to births through exact gas parents and host
branches. Derive primordial capability support from the evolved native
network. cloud_morphology measures candidates separately at each epoch.

Write first-stars.json, cloud-NNN.json and their sealed numeric bundles,
registered figure galleries and cooling-births.json in context.generation.
Return the summary with joined birth count, cloud statuses, figure count and
source hashes. Resolution/physics decisions remain in the numerical products.

functions.name: prepare_native_baryon_campaign
functions.description:
Prepare a three-stage workflow for an existing native baryon run.

request supplies the exact run and saved labels, source-accounting tolerances,
memory/disk budgets, hash-bound figure/cooling designs, identity graph and
assembly product. Verify the actual snapshot inventory and collect all input
and producer source hashes. Build the dependency graph for a hydro journal
audit, six baryon figures and the cooling/birth/cloud products.

Write request.json, workflow.json and manifest.json to a new destination.
Return the prepared campaign manifest with workflow path/checksum, requested
variants and source bindings. Execution is a later workflow operation.

functions.description: Check the existing model/build generators configure native records.

functions.name: gls
functions.description:
Fit y=A*p+noise with the declared observation covariance C.

With C=L*L.T, whiten B=L^-1*A and b=L^-1*y, then solve using B's SVD.
This avoids forming normal equations, which square the design's condition
number. Parameter covariance is V*diag(1/s^2)*V.T; influence maps original
observations to fitted parameters. C is known, so covariance is not scaled
by the fitted chi-square. Units follow the supplied data/design columns.

description:

Lightcones use no-h comoving distances and proper emission clocks. Lens planes

mass does not acquire stellar light, and thin lenses do not model strong-field
black-hole ray tracing. Periodic replicas are not independent realizations.

functions.name: species_lens_plane
functions.description:
Deposit gravitating mass and solve the thin-plane angular potential.

Sigma_crit = c^2 D_s/(4*pi*G*D_l*D_ls), with distances in proper kpc
and G in kpc*(km/s)^2/Msun. Kappa = (Sigma-Sigma_background)/Sigma_crit.
The FFT solves angular Laplacian(psi)=2*kappa for the periodic contrast;
its mean is restored as a uniform mass sheet. Deflections are radians.

functions.name: gas_metal_dust_screen
functions.description:
Integrate foreground Gaussian gas kernels into a dust optical depth.

Positions and kernel widths are proper kpc; gas masses are Msun. Each
kernel's line integral is its projected Gaussian times the fraction between
observer and star. Dust mass = gas mass * metal fraction * dust/metals.
Sigma_dust is converted to g/cm^2, tau = Sigma_dust * kappa(lambda), and
transmission = exp(-tau). This screen does not compute reprocessed IR.

functions.name: observer_fluxes
functions.description:
Convert native SSP spectra to photon-counting band-averaged f_nu in Jy.

For observer wavelength lambda_o, lambda_e=lambda_o/(1+z), and
f_lambda_o=L_lambda_e/[4*pi*D_L^2*(1+z)]. A photon-counting band gives
<f_nu>=integral(f_lambda*lambda*T dlambda)/(c*integral(T/lambda dlambda)).
Wavelengths are Angstrom, D_L is converted from kpc to cm, spectra from
Lsun/Angstrom to erg/s/Angstrom, and 1 Jy = 1e-23 erg/s/cm^2/Hz.
Unsupported SSPs or uncovered filter wavelengths remain NaN with a mask.

functions.name: noisy_survey
functions.description:
Draw correlated measurement noise without replacing intrinsic truth.

Each source supplies a covariance in Jy^2. Draw only supported bands via
V*sqrt(eigenvalues)*normal; tiny negative eigenvalues within the authored
absolute tolerance are clipped to zero. Selection is a separate source mask;
informative missingness marks observed bands across the parent catalogue.

functions.name: paired_power_statistics
functions.description:
Propagate the measured covariance of two spectra in matching bins.

A and B are powers in Mpc^3; covariance rows/columns are ordered [A, B]
and have units Mpc^6. The residual is B-A (Mpc^3), the ratio B/A is
dimensionless. Errors use C_out = J C_in J.T, retaining correlations
between spectra and between bins. Ratio errors use a first-order expansion;
the caller supplies a positive denominator floor in Mpc^3 to exclude bins
near zero. Negative shot-noise-subtracted powers remain valid measurements.

description:
Research workflows and measurements, grouped by responsibility.

capabilities: declared models, native settings and saved workflow inputs.
generator_controls: explicitly invoked MUSIC transfer and mixed-fluid checks.
controls: physical control inputs, build flags and measured native controls.
convergence: controlled variants, native input authority and paired comparisons.
measurements: native observables, history reductions and ensemble collection.
errors: correlated uncertainties, systematic envelopes and bounded refinement.
display: measured figures, graph galleries and native scene attachments.
restarts: exact native state, physical outputs and lifecycle comparisons.
checkpoints: coherent restart markers, retained copies and continuation policy.
zooms: parent material, descendant recovery and measured region adequacy.
pilots: representative campaigns, native populations and measured artifacts.
release: explicitly requested portable-build/restart/scene controls.
findings: optional failure history and supplied rerun measurements.

Shared units and simulation physics remain in their owning core modules.
Importing this package launches no work.

Decide which workflows their declared physics and saved inputs can support.

Build support requires the recorded executable, compile options and input
fields. Saved-run selection checks actual particle species, epochs and fields.
These checks establish input availability; they do not establish accuracy or
convergence of the underlying physical model.

description:

All scientific tolerances and input units are declared by the caller.
