Publish exact supported cells and adjacent measured radial intervals.

Equal descriptor fields define a group. Only exactly abutting accepted
intervals are joined. An unmeasured epoch, parameter point, or radial gap
is never filled by a bounding box or an interpolation assumption.

functions.name: evaluate_error_budget
functions.description:
Sum correlated random errors; conservatively add systematic envelopes.

joint_covariance is component-major, shape (components*bins)^2. Supplying
only component covariance requires an explicit independent_components
statement. That statement is recorded as an assumption, never inferred.

If e is the stacked component error, S = [I I ... I] sums components:
C_total = S C_joint S.T. Add nonnegative systematic bounds directly,
then s times the random standard deviation. This preserves correlation
and avoids treating a systematic envelope as a random variance. Biases,
reference values and absolute tolerances share request['units']; covariance
entries have those units squared, and relative tolerance is dimensionless.

functions.name: estimate_correlated_error_components
functions.description:
Ensemble paired differences: shape realizations x components x bins.

Distinct realizations are required by the caller; matching phases within
one realization retain cross-component correlation. No bootstrap replaces
an independent native ensemble.

C = sum_i (x_i - mean)(x_i - mean).T / (N - 1), in units squared.
This estimates variation of one realization; covariance of the ensemble
mean would instead be C/N and is not the quantity returned here.

functions.description: See implementation.

functions.name: evaluate_masked_error_budget
functions.description:
Preserve failed native bins without inventing finite uncertainty values.

Compute covariance only on the common actually supported bin subspace.
Published covariance matrices carry explicit original-bin indices; unknown
rows are represented by null scalar bounds rather than zero uncertainties.

functions.name: measure_correlated_ensemble
functions.description:
Build component-major covariance on bins observed in every paired sample.

Residuals are signed variant-minus-reference differences in the frozen
observable units. Sample covariance targets one native realization; it is
never divided by the sample count. Independently measured systematic bias
envelopes remain separate and are not replaced with an ensemble mean.

functions.name: estimate_run_resources
functions.description:
Planning estimates, not a memory allocation guarantee.

Snapshot disk calibration comes from the pinned 32^3 integration checks.
The rough RAM model budgets 256 bytes per gravity particle, another 512
per gas particle, and 64 bytes per global PM cell for density/FFT work.
Actual tree/domain/SPH allocation depends on MPI decomposition and load;
GADGET's measured allocation log is authoritative after execution.

functions.name: resolution_followup_resources
functions.description:
Bound refinement costs by actual species counts, retaining coarse levels.

Forecasts are preflight estimates; regenerated IC census/native MUSIC mesh
planning are mandatory before launch. No uniform finest N^3 assumption.

functions.name: preflight_storage
functions.description:
Estimate run storage from measured pinned-build snapshots before work starts.

The calibration is the package's completed 32^3 GADGET runs (about 1.8 MB
per DM-only snapshot and 6.3 MB per two-species hydro snapshot). Particle
data scale with species counts (N^3 by default). The estimate adds one snapshot-sized IC allowance,
50% for analysis/intermediate products and file-size variation, and a
fixed 256 MiB reserve. It is a planning bound, not a promise about output
size; callers can explicitly continue when available disk is below it.

functions.name: estimate_production_resources
functions.description:
Budget the declared particle census and mesh without altering the run.

Memory is a peak for sequential follow-ups; disk includes every retained
child. For an average of N_ngb neighbors, SIDM has N_dm*N_ngb/2 distinct
pairs. Exchange bytes multiply that pair count by boundary fraction,
endpoint payload, operator intervals and conflict rounds. Pair timings are
caller-supplied calibrations, not timings inferred from source inspection.

model. Table preparation computes model inputs; it does not evolve particles
or establish numerical convergence.

functions.description:
Invert complete data with positive parallax; negative measurements fail.

functions.name: gaussian_log_likelihood
functions.description:
Per-object normalized Gaussian marginal over measured components.

Missing values must be NaN and measured must be a boolean N×D mask.
Select the covariance submatrix, not a submatrix of the precision matrix.
Completely missing rows contribute log(1)=0. Prediction stays complete.
This assumes missingness is ignorable given the declared experiment;
informative missingness needs its own response probability.

functions.name: gaussian_mock
functions.description:
Reproducible draws with the same covariance and missing-data convention.

Negative parallaxes and outliers remain; no clipping or repeated draws.
Missingness mask is supplied explicitly, not inferred from noisy values.

functions.name: selected_mixture_log_likelihood
functions.description:
Exact selected-population mixture with a common observed-data selection.

PDFs must be normalized over identical measured coordinates, before
selection. Efficiencies must be independently evaluated integrals of s(y)
against those PDFs, including the same missing-data experiment. They are
not guessed from selected counts. Fraction is BEFORE selection. This is
conditional on inclusion, not a Poisson abundance likelihood. For latent
truth-dependent selection, integrate selection inside the component PDFs
instead; this common s(y) formula is inapplicable.

functions.name: observed_box_selection
functions.description:
Deterministic inclusive cuts on measured chart values, before masking.

bounds is D pairs of [lower, upper]; None is an unlimited endpoint.
No cuts means [[None,None], ...]. This is one explicit selection model.

functions.description:
Apply the declared error/selection experiment to an immutable stellar truth export.

Observed data and private mock truth are separate NPZ files. This is not an
inference run; response integrals and population/dynamical models remain
required. All selection cuts must use components returned as measured.

overlapping windows. Unsupported slopes, age-grid boundaries and lever arms

shared zeropoints. Correlated detection residuals need a multivariate model.

description:
Live self-gravitating stellar stripping and calibrated release adapters.

The reference integrator is deterministic direct softened gravity in an
inertial frame, coupled to the actual time-dependent parent field. This supports
collisionless stellar systems; collisional clusters and DM-bearing SIDM systems
need a native physics engine. Particle spray is a distinct approximation.

functions.name: initialize_equilibrium_model
functions.description:
Sample the exact isolated isotropic Plummer DF, not a Maxwellian guess.

f(E) proportional to (-E)^(7/2); p(q) proportional to q^2(1-q^2)^(7/2),
q=v/v_escape. Numerical force softening is recorded by the integrator and
requires a softening convergence campaign before physical acceptance.

functions.name: self_gravity
functions.description:
Direct pair forces and per-particle potential with exact self exclusion.

Phi_i=-G sum(j!=i) m_j/sqrt(|x_i-x_j|^2+eps^2) [(km/s)^2].
a_i=-G sum(j!=i) m_j*(x_i-x_j)/(|x_i-x_j|^2+eps^2)^(3/2).
Uniform Plummer softening defines the SAME force and binding potential.
Work is O(N^2); memory is O(chunk*N). Self terms contribute neither.

functions.name: measure_bound_remnant
functions.description:
Remove positive-energy particles until the softened self-bound set settles.

Specific binding energy is |v-v_bulk|^2/2+Phi_self [(km/s)^2]. This is
a self-binding definition, excluding the external tidal boundary. Starting
from all stars on each output allows previously stripped stars to recapture.

functions.name: window_response
functions.description:
Map independent real/imaginary full-box density modes to patch modes.

For delta_m = r_m + i s_m, Psi_m = i k_m delta_m/k_m^2. Reality fixes
the negative partner. Both partners contribute in a nonuniform window,
so circular complex Gaussian assumptions would give the wrong covariance.
Rows are all real outputs then all imaginary outputs; columns alternate
source real and imaginary parts. No source mode is silently truncated.

functions.name: model_window_covariance
functions.description:

For the convention delta(k)=box-volume^-1 integral delta exp(-ikx), each
independent real/imaginary mode has variance P(k)/(2 L^3). P and L use
Mpc/h; q and the box passed to the operator use native comoving kpc/h.
